action: No action needed for the public at this stage. Users of the commission's online services should rely on its official announcements and be cautious of messages claiming to come from it until the investigation reports.
exec: An attack on an election body's public website; impact is unknown and no data loss has been reported so far.
plain: Malaysia's Election Commission said its website was attacked. It is working with the communications regulator and other authorities, and the effect is still being investigated.
summary: The commission reported an attack on its website and is working with the communications regulator MCMC and other authorities. The impact is still under investigation.
title: Election Commission of Malaysia website hit by cyberattack

validation.note: Second review: Only source is SharkStriker tracker whose own entry links a 2022 NST URL, so it may recycle the 2022 attack; no 2026 official statement found.
